status: Exploratory source development. The original pose continuation gate failed; a later, explicitly post-hoc motion screen supports further investigation.
scope: Fixed A03/A07/A12 across all30 source people in E01-E03; one seed2027. Every held room has10 different people. No E04 arrays, target calibration labels, 3D or complete absolute-pose claim.

config.invalid_history_policy: Reject every canonical endpoint whose forty-frame history includes a decoder-rejected frame. Exact same mask in allarms. No filled covariance enters any retained example. Require at least90percent endpoints and all people per role.
config.feature_normalization: Source-training column mean/SD only; SD floor .001
config.rbf_bandwidth: Median squared distance of128 deterministic source-training samples after source normalization; no held data
config.rff_normalization: Source-training RFF column mean/SD only; SD floor .001
config.selection: Separate source-validation coordinate MSE per target; first alpha wins ties
config.comparison: Every arm uses identical endpoints, forty-frame raw histories, source roles, RFF512 and alpha grid; no preliminary64-dimensional projection
config.continuation_gate: Congruence-dynamics record-centered poseR2 and raw-zero-reference displacementR2 positive in all3held rooms; macro poseR2>=.05; fixed within-record shuffle lowers macro poseR2>=.05. Heuristic only, not statistical significance.
config.scope: DEVELOPMENT ONLY fixed A03/A07/A12 acrossall30sourcepeople/E01-E03; scope registered beforeanyfit. No otheraction/general efficacy/finaltest claim; no E04/targetcalibration labels. Full810recordcache integrity still verified.
config.limits: Assumes fixed complex receiver mixing per frequency bin within compared times; real room physics need not obey this. Pair invariants cannot identify unknown static pose. This is not a complete absolute-pose/calibration product or 3D/Doppler/AoA claim.

local_feasibility.scope: E01/S01/A12 only; same person/action/room, chronologically separated raw blocks with40frame histories. This does not test room transfer.

coverage.policy: The same strict invalid40framehistory mask is applied to all3 feature arms. No filled covariance enters a retained example.

normalizers.pose: Supplied2D annotation coordinates on declared640x640 isotropic reference plane, hiproot-relative34targets; no perperson/roomtarget alignment or fitted scaling
normalizers.relative_nje: Euclidean joint error divided by the current reference skeleton bounding-box diagonal; roottranslation removed from BOTHprediction andtarget for this articulation diagnostic
normalizers.pck: Fractions of that same reference bounding-box diagonal
normalizers.displacement: Root-relative pose(t)-pose(t-8), in the same coordinate units. Raw deltaR2 uses ZERO as reference:1-SSE/sum(target_delta^2). No targetmean subtraction in that metric
normalizers.centered_r2: Subtract each predicted/target recording mean separately for evaluation only. This oracle centering is not an inference input or DC recovery

matched_neural_control: Unavailable in this3action trial. Historical full27action neural runs have different budgets/data and are not paired controls here.

posthoc_motion_continuation.introduced: After observing the first E01 development score, before any full-cohort escalation; NOT the preregistered gate or final efficacy acceptance
posthoc_motion_continuation.rule: Congruence-dynamics rawzero-reference deltaR2>0 and better than fixed within-record shuffle in each of all3development rooms

limits: Source DEVELOPMENT only, one seed, represented3actions acrossnewpeople/rooms. Small positive pooled scores do not establish population significance, consistency perperson/action, unknown static pose, complete absolute reconstruction or calibrated product efficacy. E04 remains sealed.
